answer.reason: The verses only list Bebai's descendants in registers of returning families, of those with foreign wives, and of signatories, and say nothing he did or that happened to him beyond what the summary already gives.
doubts: EZR 8:11 and EZR 10:28 may concern a descendant family rather than Bebai himself; NEH 10:15 may name a different man of the same name.
